summary_en: Nippon Fine Chemical updated its approach to capital cost and stock price-conscious management on September 30, 2026, following a Board review of current performance analysis and identified challenges, with details on improvement initiatives provided in attached materials.
title_en: Response to Realizing Management with Awareness of Cost of Capital and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: On September 30, 2026, Nippon Fine Chemical's Board of Directors reviewed and updated the company's approach to realizing management with awareness of cost of capital and stock price. The Board conducted a fresh analysis of the company's current situation and identified key challenges requiring attention. Specific details regarding the content of improvement initiatives and future measures are contained in the attached materials and were presented to the market on October 1, 2026.
